questions.answer: When waves overlap, the resultant displacement is the sum of the individual displacements.
accepted_alternatives: The resultant displacement at a point is the algebraic sum of the individual wave displacements.

marking_points.text: States that when waves overlap, the resultant displacement is the sum of the individual displacements
